nodes.label: Binance Vision CDN Archive
nodes.rationale: data.binance.vision is the ONLY working source for historical OI/funding/long-short/taker data: Binance REST is geo-blocked (HTTP 451), OKX limits to ~30 days, Bybit geo-blocked. The public CDN is separate from the blocked API and hosts years of daily/monthly CSV archives; enabled the 8-column derivatives backfill (2020-09 onward, 62% coverage).
